info.title: LeaseGuard API
info.description: Commercial lease monitoring and tenant communication. LeaseGuard never collects, processes or facilitates payments. Company-owned resources require the x-company-id header.

company.name: x-company-id
company.description: Active company (workspace) id; the caller must be a member

uptimeSeconds.description: Seconds since the API process started.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip time of the check, when the dependency answered.

reason.description: Short reason when the dependency is not up. Details are in the server log.

message.description: Human-readable message, or one message per validation problem

isDefault.description: Workspace opened by default on sign-in
Workspace opened by default on sign-in

memberships.description: Memberships visible in this response. Company member lists include only the active company.

status.description: pending: waiting to be sent; sent: emailed (or, for a user with a confirmed account, shown in their app); accepted: the invitee accepted while signed in with the invited email; declined: the invitee declined; revoked: withdrawn; failed: sending failed

invitedByUserId.description: Absent for invitations created by Nexus platform tooling

invitedUserId.description: The invitee's user id, once their account exists

role.description: The role the caller gets on accepting

invitedByName.description: Name of the company admin who invited; absent for Nexus platform invitations

companyId.description: Use as X-Company-Id to open the new workspace

businessAccountId.description: Empty when WhatsApp is not configured

phoneNumberId.description: Empty when WhatsApp is not configured

accessTokenReference.description: Opaque reference to the server-side secret; never the token itself

leaseExpiryNoticeDays.description: Days before lease expiry at which expiry events are raised

renewalDeadlineWarningDays.description: Days before a renewal notice deadline at which warnings are raised

guaranteeExpiryNoticeDays.description: Days before guarantee expiry at which expiry events are raised

installmentReminderLeadDays.description: Days before an instalment due date to send its reminder

initials.description: Initials shown in the workspace switcher

leaseExpiryNoticeDays.description: Distinct positive days before lease expiry

renewalDeadlineWarningDays.description: Distinct positive days before a renewal notice deadline

guaranteeExpiryNoticeDays.description: Distinct positive days before guarantee expiry

paymentReminderOffsetsDays.description: All three offsets, increasing: initial < overdue < followUp

companyDetails.description: Name, address and contact details are filled in (required)

teamInvited.description: More than one member, or any invitation (recommended, not required)

leaseVerified.description: At least one lease is verified (required)

statementUploaded.description: At least one statement was uploaded (required)

grossLettableAreaSqm.description: Gross lettable area in square metres

whatsappVerified.description: Numbers must be verified before automated communication is enabled

percentage.description: Percentage per interval, e.g. 8 for 8%; set when type is percentage

fixedAmount.description: Rand increase per interval (ZAR); set when type is fixed_amount

cpiAssumedPercentage.description: Assumed CPI percentage; set when type is cpi_linked

renewalTermMonths.description: Length of the renewal term in months

noticePeriodMonths.description: Written notice required before expiry, in months

basisMonths.description: Deposit as months of initial rental
Months of rental the guarantee was sized as at issue

currentMonthlyRental.description: Contractual rental after applied escalations (ZAR, excl. VAT)

verified.description: Lease terms must be verified before they drive financial monitoring

storagePath.description: Object path in the statements bucket: <companyId>/<statementId>/<file>

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file

amount.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals; always positive, `kind` gives the direction

flagged.description: Extraction confidence for this line was below threshold

openingBalance.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals. Present only once verified.

rentalCharged.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals. Present only once verified.

additionalCharges.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals. Present only once verified.

paymentsReceived.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals. Present only once verified.

closingBalance.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals; outstanding balance owed by the tenant. Present only once verified.

totalDue.description: Rands (ZAR), 2 decimals. Present only once verified.

processingError.description: Why automatic processing could not complete; the statement needs manual review

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes; at most DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_MAX_FILE_MB

statementId.description: Id the statement will have once registered

signedUrl.description: Upload the file here with PUT, or with supabase-js uploadToSignedUrl(storagePath, token, file)

storagePath.description: storagePath returned by createStatementUploadUrl, after the file was uploaded

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the uploaded file

duplicate.description: A likely duplicate (same tenant, period and number) for the reviewer to check; null when none

processingJobId.description: Processing job id; null when the queue was unavailable (call processStatement to retry)

message.description: Human-readable message, or one message per validation problem

duplicate.description: The statement already registered with this file

rawText.description: Document text the value was read from

value.description: Null when not found; never guessed

flagged.description: A person must check this value

EnqueueOutcome.description: added: a new job was queued; already_queued: the job is still waiting or running and was left alone; retried: a permanently failed job was run again; requeued: a completed job that did not move the statement on was queued again

jobId.description: Deterministic job id; repeated calls return the same id

outcome.description: added: a new job was queued; already_queued: the job is still waiting or running and was left alone; retried: a permanently failed job was run again; requeued: a completed job that did not move the statement on was queued again

steps.description: How the figures were calculated, step by step

note.description: Required when dismissing (the dismissal reason); otherwise stored as resolution notes

confirmedByUserId.description: Confirmed from an updated statement or by the property manager; LeaseGuard never verifies bank transactions

outstandingBalance.description: Outstanding balance at the time of agreement, rands (ZAR)

suppressArrearsReminders.description: While active, normal arrears reminders are paused for this tenant

ownerUserId.description: Property owner user, for owner messages

companyNumber.description: The company's own WhatsApp Business number

approvalId.description: The approval request governing this message: the open one, otherwise the most recent

reason.description: Note recorded with the decision; always present for a rejection

note.description: Optional note kept with the approval

link.description: The record the notification is about

updated.description: Notifications that changed from unread to read

actorUserId.description: Absent for actions taken by background jobs

updatedAt.description: Equal to createdAt: entries are never updated
